title: Deep-learning feature-guided design yields antimicrobial peptides D1 and D2
summary: DLFea4AMPGen uses deep-learning activity models and SHAP feature attribution to define peptide fragments used in a candidate sequence space. Sixteen selected peptides were synthesized; the primary article reports 12 with at least two tested activities and identifies D1 and D2 as active against drug-resistant bacterial isolates. D1 also reduced bacterial load in a reported mouse infection experiment. This is preclinical evidence, not human treatment or safety; the study does not establish that every generated sequence or all three activity classes were validated.
